```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(shokenuse)
```

The Data tab loads the token-metrics files. Every other tab reads what this tab loads, so start here when a number looks wrong.

## Loading files

| Input | Description |
|---|---|
| Token-metrics folder | Folder of daily `YYYY-MM-DD-token-metrics.csv` files. Defaults to the `dir` argument of `launch_app()` (`~/.cache/token-metrics`). |
| Reload folder | Reads the folder again. The folder is also read once when the app starts. |
| Add token-metrics CSVs | Upload one or more files, for example from another computer. Uploaded rows are added to the folder rows and duplicate rows are dropped. |

Every file must have the columns `date`, `session`, `project`, `directory`, `url`, `prompt`, `tokens`, and `cost`. A file without them shows an error notification and is skipped. See `vignette("token-metrics")` for what each column means and how the files are made.

## Checking what loaded

A status line gives the number of prompts, sessions, and projects, and the first and last day. The table below it lists the 20 latest prompts.

## Reading files in R

`util_read_token_metrics()` does the same read as the tab. It takes a folder or a vector of files:

```{r}
#| label: read
metrics <- util_read_token_metrics("~/.cache/token-metrics")

# Or a set of files
files <- fs::dir_ls("~/.cache/token-metrics", glob = "*2026-11-2*")
util_read_token_metrics(files)
```

The result has one more column than the files: `day`, the local date of `date`. Blank `url` and `cost` values become `NA`. Duplicate rows are removed, and rows are sorted by time.

## Filters

The sidebar filters apply to every tab after Data:

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| Date range | Set to the first and last day in the data whenever data loads. |
| Projects | Leave empty for all projects, or pick one or more. |
